name: kinora
description: Kinora — a video platform with timeline Moments, private timestamped notes and mood-based discovery

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('backend/.env')){const c=require('crypto');fs.writeFileSync('backend/.env',fs.readFileSync('backend/.env.example','utf8').replace('change-me-access-secret',c.randomBytes(32).toString('hex')).replace('change-me-refresh-secret',c.randomBytes(32).toString('hex')));console.log('Created backend/.env')}"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
